name: PEXA Group Limited
summary: PEXA Group Limited operates as electronic lodgement networks with various ancillary property transaction businesses and products in Australia and the United Kingdom. The company's products include PEXA, a flagship brand that provides exchange services; PEXA Clear, an anti-money laundering and counter-terrorism financing (AML/CTF) compliance platform for property industry; Optima Legal, a high-volume remortgage processing which includes legal services in remortgage market; and Smoove, a conveyancing technology provider.
